statement: ByteDance is reported to plan an order of one million of the new Nvidia professional chips to power its AI models.
why: A single-customer order of that unit scale would be a material incremental design win for Nvidia in China, though the figure comes from unverified reporting and carries no registered unit.

impact.mechanism: A large platform committing to a specific Nvidia part locks that part into its inference fleet and pulls through associated memory and board content.

evidence.excerpt: ByteDance plans to order 1 million of the chips to power its AI models.

confidence.basis: Described in the document as a separately reported detail resting on anonymous sourcing that the wire could not verify.
